description: Risicovolle elektriciteitskasten bui 70 mm Samenwerking Noordelijke Vechtstromen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.geodataoverijssel.nl. This map layer shows the location of electrical cabinets that are at risk of flooding in a 70 mm downpour. Water in electrical cabinets can cause a risk of short-circuiting. The source data comes from the Noordelijke Vechtstrooms Cooperation (SNV). Only the data on the territory of Overijssel is visualized. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Risky power cabinets shower 70 mm Collaboration Northern Fight Currents" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
